an3.99:1.1: navopi bhikkhave potthako dubbaṇṇo ca hoti dukkhasamphasso ca appaggho ca
an3.99:1.2: majjhimopi bhikkhave potthako dubbaṇṇo ca hoti dukkhasamphasso ca appaggho ca
an3.99:1.3: jiṇṇopi bhikkhave potthako dubbaṇṇo ca hoti dukkhasamphasso ca appaggho ca.
an3.99:1.4: jiṇṇampi bhikkhave potthakaṃ ukkhaliparimaddanaṃ vā karonti saṃkārakūṭe vā naṃ chaḍḍenti.
an3.99:2.1: evameva kho bhikkhave navo cepi bhikkhu hoti dussīlo pāpadhammo
an3.99:2.3: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave potthako dubbaṇṇo tathūpamāhaṃ bhikkhave imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi.
an3.99:2.4: ye kho panassa sevanti bhajanti payirupāsanti diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjanti tesantaṃ hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya
an3.99:2.6: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave potthako dukkhasamphasso tathūpamāhaṃ bhikkhave imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi.
an3.99:2.7: yesaṃ kho pana paṭiggaṇhāti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ tesantaṃ na mahapphalaṃ hoti na mahānisaṃsaṃ
an3.99:2.9: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave potthako appaggho tathūpamāhaṃ bhikkhave imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi.
an3.99:2.11: thero cepi bhikkhave bhikkhu hoti dussīlo pāpadhammo idamassa dubbaṇṇatāya vadāmi
an3.99:2.12: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave potthako dubbaṇṇo tathūpamāhaṃ bhikkhave imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi.
an3.99:2.13: ye kho panassa sevanti bhajanti payirupāsanti diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjanti tesantaṃ hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya
an3.99:2.15: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave potthako dukkhasamphasso tathūpamāhaṃ bhikkhave imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi.
an3.99:2.16: yesaṃ kho pana paṭiggaṇhāti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ tesantaṃ na mahapphalaṃ hoti na mahānisaṃsaṃ
an3.99:2.18: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave potthako appaggho tathūpamāhaṃ bhikkhave imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi.
an3.99:3.1: evarūpo cāyaṃ bhikkhave thero bhikkhu saṃghamajjhe bhaṇati.
an3.99:3.3: kiṃ kho tuyhaṃ bālassa abyattassa bhaṇitena
an3.99:3.5: so kupito anattamano tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ nicchāreti yathārūpāya vācāya saṃgho ukkhipati saṃkārakūṭeva naṃ potthakaṃ.
an3.99:4.1: navampi bhikkhave kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ vaṇṇavantañceva hoti sukhasamphassañca mahagghañca majjhimampi bhikkhave kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ vaṇṇavantañceva hoti sukhasamphassañca mahagghañca jiṇṇampi bhikkhave kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ vaṇṇavantañceva hoti sukhasamphassañca mahagghañca.
an3.99:4.2: jiṇṇampi bhikkhave kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ ratanapaliveṭhanaṃ vā karonti gandhakaraṇḍake vā naṃ nikkhipanti.
an3.99:5.1: evameva kho bhikkhave navo cepi bhikkhu hoti sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo idamassa suvaṇṇatāya vadāmi
an3.99:5.2: seyyathāpi taṃ bhikkhave kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ vaṇṇavantaṃ tathūpamāhaṃ bhikkhave imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi.
an3.99:5.3: ye kho panassa sevanti bhajanti payirupāsanti diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjanti tesantaṃ hoti dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya
an3.99:5.5: seyyathāpi taṃ bhikkhave kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ sukhasamphassaṃ tathūpamāhaṃ bhikkhave imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi.
an3.99:5.6: yesaṃ kho pana paṭiggaṇhāti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ tesantaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti mahānisaṃsaṃ
an3.99:5.8: seyyathāpi taṃ bhikkhave kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ mahagghaṃ tathūpamāhaṃ bhikkhave imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi.
an3.99:5.10: thero cepi bhikkhave bhikkhu hoti sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo idamassa suvaṇṇatāya vadāmi seyyathāpi taṃ bhikkhave kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ vaṇṇavantaṃ tathūpamāhaṃ bhikkhave imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi. ye kho panassa sevanti bhajanti payirupāsanti diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjanti tesantaṃ hoti dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya idamassa sukhasamphassatāya vadāmi seyyathāpi taṃ bhikkhave kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ sukhasamphassaṃ tathūpamāhaṃ bhikkhave imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi. yesaṃ kho pana paṭiggaṇhāti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ tesantaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti mahānisaṃsaṃ idamassa mahagghatāya vadāmi seyyathāpi taṃ bhikkhave kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ mahagghaṃ tathūpamāhaṃ bhikkhave imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi.
an3.99:6.1: evarūpo cāyaṃ bhikkhave thero bhikkhu saṃghamajjhe bhaṇati.
an3.99:6.3: appasaddā āyasmanto hotha thero bhikkhu dhammañca vinayañca bhaṇatīti
